description: Get the build log of a deploy (compilation errors, dependency issues), read at its provider. Most useful for diagnosing a failed deploy. Runtime output (crashes, request errors) is the app's live log: use get_app_logs.

deploy_id.description: The deploy ID to get logs for.

log_type.description: build (the default and the only value): the deploy's build log. For runtime output use get_app_logs.

name: get_deploy_logs
